page0.text:
"Sakura thinks we had a fight?"
"Huh? I mean, didn't you? She said it was her fault."

page1.text: "...It might have appeared that way, but Sakura was correct. Far from being a quarrel, it was a conversation that brought my inadequacies to light..."

page2.text:
...
Wow.
Saber's grumbling at herself.
Not that it does a thing to stop her chopsticks from delivering bite after bite of food to her mouth.

page3.text: "No, sorry I phrased it weirdly. I was curious because of how much it bothers Sakura. Just forget it."

page4.text:
"Haah... both of you keep saying the same thing. Are you perhaps teaming up to tease me?"
"Why would I go out of my way just to prank you!? And what would Sakura and I have to gain from that?"
Actually, I'm terrified of pranking Saber and being found out.

page5.text:
"That's true. Then, I suppose it is your mutual way of being considerate to me."
Saber muses as she ingests an omelette.
It's good to be a glutton in the morning. Mm-hm.

page6.text:
"But I wonder what Sakura meant. She wouldn't feel that down if it was something petty. Do you mind telling me, Saber?"
"W-well, it was simply that I was too weak of a Servant. To put it briefly, I failed to protect you due to my lack of skill."

page7.text:
"...I think you're doing more than plenty on that front.
I just went and fainted on my own last night. You don't need to beat yourself up over it."

page8.text:
"That may be true...but Sakura was right to warn me. It was wrong of me to be unwilling to listen to her.
No matter what Sakura says, I am making you, my Master, fight in a war."

page9.text:
Saber looks away uncomfortably.
"Hm?"
I mean, it's strange.
Why is Saber getting so worked up over something that we already mutually agreed on?

page10.text: "...unclear. Residents reporting suspicious behavior have requested that authorities investigate houses in the area."

page11.text:
The news is on TV.
I turned on the TV while eating, and it's showing a story about last night's events.

page12.text:
"Thirty people were found in serious condition and taken immediately to the hospital.
This marks the seventh mass coma incident this month. Medical exams suggest something akin to food poisoning..."

page13.text:
I finish breakfast and get ready for school.
I'm going to school to see Tohsaka.
I need to discuss what happened last night with her—about Zouken Matou and that black Shadow.

page14.text: "Police strongly suspect that the fresh wave of victims across Miyama South 4-chome was caused by the spread of some drug..."

page15.text:
Miyama South 4-chome.
Tohsaka was glaring in that direction last night.
...Archer said that the Shadow was causing the comas.

page16.text:
Thirty unconscious people.
I've experienced for myself what that was like.
Like Caster, the Shadow lurks in the dark and sucks magical energy from people around town.

page17.text:
...
No, it's more than just "sucking."
Caster had a gentle touch, compared to that thing.
She cleverly made sure to harvest energy from people in a repeatable, painless way.
Like drawing blood through a syringe, to use a metaphor.

page18.text:
...This is nothing like that.
Caster may have only drawn blood, but the thing I saw last night feasts on its victims.
The Shadow has no mind or mercy. It only cares about devouring its victims' magical energy, mind and all.

page19.text:
"Saber. I need to talk to you before I leave for school."
"Yes, what is it, Shirou?"

page20.text:
Saber heard what they said on the news, too.
She probably knows what I'm about to say, but she quietly waits for me to continue, as always.

page21.text:
"It's about our direction going forward. You saw that thing last night, right?"
"Yes. It was like nothing I have ever seen, and resembled no Phantasmal species that I know of."

page22.text:
"...Yeah. I don't know what it is.
But it's our enemy. It didn't look like a Master or Servant, but it deliberately targeted me and Tohsaka, and it's been taking magical energy from people around town.
Then..."

page23.text:
"...We are going to prioritize finding that Shadow?
You want us to go after something that has nothing to do with us, and ignore the other Masters and Servants?"

page24.text:
Saber gives me a hard stare.
...Her goal is to obtain the Holy Grail.
And I'm asking her to help me with an irrelevant objective.
Of course she'd be against it.
But still...

page25.text:
"Yeah. We can't leave it alone. I think it takes priority over the Holy Grail War."
...
Saber watches me silently for a moment.
The deafening silence makes me hold my breath.

page26.text:
"...Haah. Goodness, I guessed it might come to this. I'd rather not get involved with that Shadow, but..."
"Huh? Saber? Are you sure about this?"

page27.text:
"Whether I am or not, I know that you would go off on your own even if I refused.
In that case, it would completely defeat my purpose here. If I allow you to die, then I will also be unable to remain in this era.
So I will go along with you, despite whatever misgivings I may have."

page28.text:
"Urgh. Well, yeah, but..."
"Besides, it is only a matter of time before you repeat yesterday's recklessness if I leave you alone. That was the second time, so there is bound to be a third. I will be forced to apologize to Sakura if it happens again."

page29.text:
"Then..."
"A Servant should follow its Master's orders, even if I am extremely reluctant to do so. If you have made your decision, Shirou, then I will lend my sword to your effort."

page30.text:
"...Saber."
"But Shirou, that Shadow is no ordinary opponent. Even Berserker would be easier to bring down."

page31.text:
"Oof...yeah, I felt that on my own skin.
You...can't really describe it as strong or weak. It's pure misfortune. It isn't something you can beat up until it goes down."

page32.text:
"I have nothing else to add if you understand that.
...But Shirou, choosing to go after it is the most difficult path of all. Please keep that in mind."

page33.text: "...? I mean, I'll be careful, but why would you say that? Do you know what it is, like Archer?"

page34.text: "...No, I am in the same position as you. I have no idea what the Shadow is."

page35.text:
Saber averts her gaze.
Then, as if uttering an ominous premonition she just had...
